title: Como o KizuBot pesca
concept: Blueprint FIG. 5: a fishing rod traces itself on drafting paper and five numbered callouts walk through the cycle — the reel picks one of the 6 real fishing modes, the bobber waits, the bite (music drop) and the pull at the moment of the bite, the minigame gets solved, and the cycle repeats on its own — closing on 'Pesca no AFK.'
claims: modos de pesca: padrão, visão direta, água limpa, céu aberto, mesmo andar, agressivo — changelog 23/05/2026
módulo Fishing: modos e tempo da fisgada (hook timing)

pinned_comment: Pesca na mão: paciência ou sofrimento? 🎣
notes: Hook changed from 'COMO ELE PESCA.' to 'COMO O KIZUBOT PESCA.' after the first render: 'ele' was ambiguous for cold viewers and the only early brand cue was the decorative title block. Step 3 reworded from 'puxa no tempo certo, com delay humanizado' to 'puxa na hora da fisgada': BRIEF documents hook timing as a Fishing setting and humanization in general, but not a humanized fishing delay. Step 4 says 'resolve o minigame' (the pesca minigame is in the 23/05/2026 reliability update); step 5 'e repete sozinho'. Music drop on the bite. Loop bridge returns to the hook.
